title: Inside Mari
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Reclusive college dropout Isao Komori seems to wake up in the body of high school girl Mari Yoshizaki, while his own self carries on elsewhere. With Mari's classmate Yori Kakiguchi he investigates, and they find the real cause of the 'swap' lies in Mari's own troubled mind. Content advisory: the series has nudity and psychosexual material involving a high school character, and a Sydney bookstore pulled it in 2020 pending classification after a legal complaint.
life_message: It suggests that facing one's own pain and identity, rather than escaping into someone else, is the way back to living.
